draftMeta.purpose: New-generation contract for char_resident; no runtime asset is authorized by this file.

roleIdentityLimits.intendedRole: Adult general town resident: a non-combat local citizen with a simple, readable daily-life silhouette and no required profession-specific tool.
roleIdentityLimits.individualIdentity: A new NPC individual, distinct from the player and every other NPC. The candidate must not be represented as a user-direct source, a user identity, or a continuation of any historical character candidate.
distinguishFrom: The town clerk: no required civic ledger, quill, official uniform, badge, or readable paperwork.
The innkeeper: no required apron, serving prop, or tavern-worker identity.
Combatants: no weapon, armor, quest marker, UI, or text.

characterStyleAuthority.role: sole style authority for this distinct NPC

draftMeta.styleLock: Use the exact sole authority for crisp pixel density, stable head/body proportions, contour weight, silhouette readability, and restrained 2–3-step shading. Preserve the fixed 4x10 sheet, independently drawn east row, transparent surroundings, no chroma residue, and no UI/text.
draftMeta.historicalCandidatePolicy: All earlier character candidates, generated sheets, and deployed character art are prohibited as visual references, derivation inputs, comparison authorities, or runtime-promotion sources. They may remain quarantined as historical records only.
draftMeta.formalIntake: required for a future new candidate; no historical candidate carries forward.
draftMeta.humanReview: required for a future new candidate; not submitted or authorized by this contract.
draftMeta.runtime: explicitly disallowed; no runtime path is assigned.
